solutions.check: grid and clues read from the FT's printable PDF, its numbering matching the clue list; every fifteensquared answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: King is satisfied with fortune

parts.note: K is the chess and card abbreviation for king
to have met a need is to have satisfied it

explanation.surface: A monarch content with his lot in life.
explanation.definitionFit: Kismet is a word for fate or destiny, the fortune allotted to someone.

clue.text: Chemical compound, a little, identified in stomach of girl?

indicators.note: the small amount is identified sitting inside the middle letters, so one piece goes inside the other
the stomach is the middle of the body, so the central letters of the word girl are taken

parts.note: some means a little, an unspecified small amount

explanation.surface: A chemist finds a trace of some compound in a girl's stomach.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the cryptic reading of 'stomach': the middle of the word, not a girl's belly.
explanation.definitionFit: An isomer is a chemical compound sharing its formula with another but differing in structure.

clue.text: Mother, not able to hear one, grimaced

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother
deaf means unable to hear
an ace counts as one in cards and dice

explanation.surface: A mother who cannot hear someone pulls a face in frustration.
explanation.definitionFit: To make a face is an idiom for contorting the features, i.e. to grimace.

clue.text: Place shabby articles in long dissertations

indicators.note: the shabby goods are placed inside the dissertations, one word within the other

parts.note: theses are long dissertations written for a degree
tat is cheap, shoddy goods

explanation.surface: Someone stuffs worthless junk into lengthy academic dissertations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Place' looks like a verb instructing you to put something somewhere, but it is the noun definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The States is a common name for the USA, a place or country.

clue.text: Surgical procedure is set in time to achieve the best possible result

parts.note: op is short for an operation, a surgical procedure

indicators.note: is is set inside the word for time, one piece placed within another

parts.note: taken as the word time itself

explanation.surface: An operation is scheduled at the right time to get the best outcome.
explanation.definitionFit: To optimise is to make something as effective as possible, getting the best result.

clue.text: Policeman, one caught in arms of volunteer

indicators.note: being held in someone's arms means being enclosed, so these letters go inside the word for volunteer

parts.note: to volunteer something is to offer it
I is the Roman numeral for one
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A constable caught and held by a member of the volunteer force.
explanation.definitionFit: A police officer is a policeman, officer being the general rank-and-file term.

clue.text: Give a point to recording artist

definitions.meaning: to make it narrow to a point
taken literally, one who tapes, someone recording on tape

explanation.definitionFit: Taper means to narrow to a point, and humorously means one who makes tape recordings.

clue.text: Store taking delivery of cold meat in small portions

indicators.note: the store receives the letter like a parcel delivered into it, so it goes inside

parts.note: a mine is a rich store or source of something
C is the abbreviation for cold on taps

explanation.surface: A shop receives a delivery of cold meat sliced into small pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Mince is meat that has been chopped or ground into very small pieces.

clue.text: Frightening cry can start to generate gunfire

parts.note: shoo is the cry used to scare away animals
a tin is a can

indicators.note: the start of the word generate gives its first letter

explanation.surface: A scary shout could set off a burst of firing.
explanation.definitionFit: Shooting is the firing of guns, so it is a synonym of gunfire.

clue.text: Expensive film deal arranged in club game

indicators.note: the rearranged letters sit inside the game's name, one piece within another

parts.note: golf is played with clubs

indicators.note: arranging letters means putting them into a new order

explanation.surface: A business deal is set up over a round of golf at the club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranged' reorders DEAL. 'Expensive film' is not a movie but a thin, costly layer.
explanation.definitionFit: Gold leaf is gold beaten into a very thin, costly sheet or layer.

clue.text: Old money largely being supported by standard

indicators.note: largely means most of the word, so its final letter is dropped

parts.note: the old penny, pre-decimal British coinage
on means resting on top of, supported by

explanation.surface: Old currency mostly backed by the gold standard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'largely' cuts PENNY to PENN. In a down-style charade ON comes last as the thing being supported.
explanation.definitionFit: A pennon is a long flag or banner, and a standard is a military flag.

clue.text: Section of camp making room for an individual bound by lease

indicators.note: the tent makes room inside for the extra letters, so they go within it

parts.note: a tent is one unit or section of a camp

explanation.surface: A section of a camp has space for someone under contract.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenant occupies property under the terms of a lease agreement.

clue.text: Check temperature limited by part of a nuclear reactor in warship

indicators.note: being limited means bounded on each side, so these letters go inside the reactor part

parts.note: the core is the central part of a nuclear reactor
to vet is to check

explanation.surface: Engineers check the temperature of a reactor core aboard a warship.
explanation.definitionFit: A corvette is a small, fast naval escort vessel, a type of warship.

clue.text: The box overturned containing a large tank

indicators.note: the reversed letters hold the other letter inside them
in a down clue overturned means read from the bottom up

parts.note: the box is British slang for television, TV

explanation.surface: A television tipped over into a big tank.
explanation.definitionFit: A vat is a large container for liquids, a big tank or tub.

clue.text: Exchanges involving heat convert electrically charged particles

parts.note: to alter is to change or convert
cations are positively charged ions

explanation.surface: Heated physics lessons on converting charged particles.
explanation.definitionFit: Altercations are angry disputes, heated exchanges of words.

clue.text: A feature of stage is coming down

parts.note: lighting is one feature of a theatre stage

explanation.surface: Stage lighting is being lowered into place.
explanation.definitionFit: Alighting means descending or landing, as a bird or passenger comes down.

clue.text: Batting star, with position not written down, makes changes

parts.note: in cricket the side batting is in
a nova is a star that suddenly brightens

indicators.note: in a down clue, not written downwards means read upwards, so the letters are reversed

parts.note: to set something is to position it

explanation.surface: A star batsman, his position unrecorded, makes alterations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not written down' turns SET into TES, read upwards in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: To innovate is to introduce new methods, making changes.

clue.text: Shut up about extra insurance

indicators.note: the cage goes round about the other word, holding it inside

parts.note: to cage is to shut up or confine
over means extra, left over

explanation.surface: Keep quiet about extra insurance.
explanation.definitionFit: Coverage is the protection given by an insurance policy.

clue.text: Two parties switched on large generator of electricity

indicators.note: switched means changed around, so the letters swap places

explanation.surface: Two political parties come to power, switching on a generator.
explanation.walkthrough: 'switched' looks like it belongs with 'on', as in switched on, but it is the anagram signal; 'on' stays unscrambled at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A power station is a plant that generates electricity on a large scale.

clue.text: Shareholders of distillery evaluated whisky

indicators.note: read literally, the words hold a share of the answer within them, its letters across the gap

explanation.surface: Shareholders of a distillery value its whisky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shareholders of' points to RYE within distilleRY Evaluated.
explanation.definitionFit: Rye is whiskey distilled from rye grain, popular in North America.

clue.text: A worker who doesn't always get to work in time, doubled effort

indicators.note: the worker goes inside the doubled letter, one piece within another
doubled means the letter is written twice

parts.words: worker who doesn't always get to work
parts.note: a temp works only intermittently, temporarily

explanation.surface: A casual worker who only sometimes has work makes a double effort to be on time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doubled' makes TT, and TEMP goes inside it after A.
explanation.definitionFit: An attempt is a try or effort at something.

clue.text: A person hugging tree is enthusiastic

indicators.note: hugging means wrapping around, so the person encloses the tree

parts.note: one means a person, as in one should
a fir is a coniferous tree

explanation.surface: A tree-hugger is passionate about the cause.
explanation.definitionFit: On fire is an idiom for performing brilliantly or being passionately keen.

clue.text: Sort of anger bottled up by hardened military man

indicators.note: bottled up means held inside, so the rearranged letters go within the other word

parts.note: set means hardened, as concrete sets

indicators.note: to sort letters is to rearrange them

explanation.surface: A hardened soldier keeps some kind of anger bottled up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sort of' signals rearranging ANGER into RGEAN; 'hardened' is the past participle sense of set, as concrete sets.
explanation.definitionFit: A sergeant is a non-commissioned officer, a military man.

clue.text: Puff served with duck and relish

parts.note: a gust is a puff of wind
duck in cricket is a score of zero, shaped like O

explanation.surface: A puff pastry served with duck and a condiment.
explanation.definitionFit: Gusto is enthusiastic enjoyment, and relish also means keen enjoyment.

clue.text: Come to a watery track

parts.note: a wake is the trail left by a boat on water

explanation.surface: Arriving at a track through water.
explanation.definitionFit: To come to is to regain consciousness, which is to awake.

clue.text: Shelters consist of poles

parts.note: to have can mean to contain or consist of
N for the north pole
S for the south pole

explanation.surface: Shelters are made of wooden poles.
explanation.definitionFit: Havens are places of safety, refuges or shelters.

clue.text: Sodium application linked to a sickness

parts.note: Na is the chemical symbol for sodium
use means application, putting to use

explanation.surface: Applying sodium is linked to feeling sick.
explanation.definitionFit: Nausea is a feeling of sickness with an urge to vomit.

clue.text: Important metal found outside a claim

parts.note: main means principal, important

indicators.note: the metal is found outside, wrapped round the other letter

parts.note: tin is a metallic element

explanation.surface: An important metal is found outside a mining claim.
explanation.definitionFit: To maintain is to assert or claim something firmly.

clue.text: Fragrant letter's due about a beneficial amount

indicators.note: the rent goes round about the other word, holding it inside

parts.note: a letter is one who lets property, and the rent is what is owed to them
the dole is a state benefit payment

explanation.surface: A fragrant letter arrives about a welfare payment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'letter' is not correspondence but a landlord, one who lets.
explanation.definitionFit: Redolent means smelling strongly of something, fragrant or aromatic.

clue.text: It helps seal request listed in contract

indicators.note: the request is listed within the contract, so it goes inside

parts.note: to get an illness is to contract it
to ask is to request

explanation.surface: A request is written into the terms of a contract to help seal it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contract' is the verb for catching a disease, not a legal document.
explanation.definitionFit: A gasket is a ring or sheet that makes a seal between joined surfaces.
